description: This file defines pin configuration and bias register mappings for Renesas R-Car Gen4 SoC, including drive and bias register structures, and functions to retrieve register info.

methods.name: pfc_rcar_get_bias_regs
methods.description: Returns pointer to array of bias register configurations.

methods.name: pfc_rcar_get_drive_regs
methods.description: Returns pointer to array of drive register configurations.

methods.name: pfc_rcar_get_reg_index
methods.description: Calculates register index from pin number, returns error if invalid.
